name: Smart and Skilled fee-free training for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students
summary: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people living or working in NSW may study Smart and Skilled courses fee-free.
key: If you identify as an Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander, you may qualify for fee-free training under Smart and Skilled.
who: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people living or working in NSW or a recognised border area.
